name: FLUX.3 Klein — text to image
description: Generate an image from a text prompt with Black Forest Labs' FLUX.3 Image Klein base model (50 steps at guidance 3.5, the higher-quality and slower one). Write full sentences: subject, action, setting, light, style; put any text to render in "quotes". FLUX.3 likes a detailed caption — if you would rather write a short idea, tick "Improve the prompt with AI" and a Qwen 3.5 model expands it first, but on this machine that adds about 3 minutes. Experimental.
author: Template - ComfyUI (FLUX.3 Image Klein)
